messages:
ryan-acme: Hi – after switching projects in the console yesterday I can only view resources, all buttons are disabled and when I try the API with our service key we get 403s. happened after an org->project transfer.

alex-support: sorry about that. can you confirm the project id and the email you're logged in as? also, did you use SSO to sign in?

ryan-acme: project: proj-88f4, org: acme-cloud, i'm signed in via Okta SSO (ryan@acme.com). API call example: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer svc_ABC123\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/proj-88f4` -> returns 403: `{\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"message\":\"insufficient_scope: project:write required\"}`

alex-support: thanks. quick check: is the svc_ token a project-scoped service key or an org-level key?

ryan-acme: it's a service token we created under the project a few months ago via the console (Service Keys -> Create). worked fine until yesterday.

maria-cs: tagging in platform to see if there was a role propagation job around that time. @sam-platform can you check audit logs for role changes on proj-88f4?

sam-platform: looked at audit stream — there was an IdP sync at 2026-03-27T21:05:10Z that updated group memberships for acme-cloud. also a project transfer job at 2026-03-27T21:04:58Z. seeing an entry: `resync: groups=[acme-eng, acme-admins] changed for user ryan@acme.com`

sam-platform: the service key itself shows `bound_to_project: proj-88f4` but the effective scopes returned by auth service are `scopes: [project:view, project:read_logs]` — missing `project:write`. not sure why the key lost the write scope.

okta-bot: IdP sync completed for org acme-cloud at 2026-03-27T21:05:10Z (changed membership: ryan@acme.com added to acme-eng, removed from acme-admins)

alex-support: that explains it — looks like during the IdP sync ryan lost membership in the admin group which granted the key a wider scope via group-bound role assignment. two pathways: 1) re-add ryan to acme-admins in Okta, or 2) create a new project-scoped service key with explicit write scopes and rotate. which do you prefer?

ryan-acme: prefer to avoid changing Okta if possible. can we rotate the key? will that affect running services? this key is used by one background worker in prod.

sam-platform: if you create a new key and roll it into the worker, there is a short switch but you can keep both active during rollout. alternatively we can do a temporary grant: join ryan back to acme-admins in IdP, let sync, then verify, then remove.

alex-support: for quick repro, can you run this from your machine and paste response headers? `curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer svc_ABC123\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/proj-88f4/resources`

ryan-acme: pasted: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 21:12:03 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: rdx-2a9f
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "insufficient_scope: project:write required",
  "hint": "service key scopes come from role assignments; check user/group role mapping"
}
```

alex-support: perfect. i'm going to open a short-lived escalation to platform to confirm role-derived scopes and if there's any automation that may have stripped scopes from existing keys during the transfer. sam, can you confirm whether we have any cleanup jobs?

sam-platform: we do have a project-transfer reconciliation that tries to sanitize inherited roles. it attempted to normalize role assignments after transfer and it looks like it re-evaluated service keys against new memberships and removed the write scope because the key owner (ryan) was not in a group that maps to project:write post-transfer. this is expected but unfortunate.

maria-cs: noted — we should surface this in the UI warning during transfer. for now action plan: 1) quick: create a new project service key with write scope and rotate worker; 2) medium: if you want the original behavior, re-add ryan to acme-admins in IdP and we'll re-evaluate; 3) long: add a preserve-scopes flag to transfer flow or warn users. ryan which option?

ryan-acme: we'll do key rotate to avoid touching IdP today. can you help make a new key with `scopes: [project:read, project:write, embeddings:use]` and provide rotation steps?

alex-support: created a support ticket with instructions and a temporary helper script. script: `./rotate-key.sh --old svc_ABC123 --project proj-88f4 --new-scope project:write,project:read,embeddings:use` — it will stage a new key, update the worker env var config, and leave old key active for 30m before auto-revoke. I'll DM you the ticket link.

ryan-acme: thanks — rotation done and worker switched, logs show no 403s now. can we close?

sam-platform: i'll file a follow-up to add a transfer warning and preservation opt-in. put it on our backlog.

alex-support: closing here but leaving the ticket open for the backlog item. please reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

ryan-acme: appreciate the help, thanks everyone.
